title: Boring beats brilliant when scope explodes #effort #reality
summary: This post argues that prioritizing simple, boring solutions is more effective than pursuing brilliant but complex ones as project scope increases. It suggests that maintainability and effort management are critical for long-term project success.

title: HERMES.md in commit messages causes requests to route to extra usage billing
summary: A technical issue exists where the presence of a "HERMES.md" file in commit messages triggers unintended routing, resulting in additional usage billing for users. This indicates an flaw in how the system's request router parses or categorizes repository metadata.

title: Where the goblins came from
summary: This article examines the historical and etymological origins of the term "goblin" within European folklore and literature. It traces the development of the creature's depiction across different cultural traditions and linguistic roots.
